descriptions.w3d_d26b_light_tables_8008f7c4: Light table setup: fills the 256-entry table 0x80433760 with 1 for every index whose high nibble has a bit set outside its low nibble unless that masked value is 0 or 0xf0, normalizes the first vectors of four records (0x804336a0, 0x804336b8, 0x804336d0, 0x804336e8) through 0x802e82c0, halves them, then normalizes their second vectors (0x804336ac, 0x804336c4, 0x804336dc, 0x804336f4).
